newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell 58.11 points to 6,925.07.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks fell 5.93 points to 1,259.44.
* Telekom Malaysia reported a 19.4 percent rise in 1996 net profit to 1.88 billion ringgit, slightly above market analysts' forecasts. It also announced a one-for-two bonus issue.
* Malaysian Tobacco reported a 38.4 percent decline in 1996 net profit.
* Bolton posted a 42.7 percent increase in 1996 net profit.
